description: A release attempt where most but not all claims link to a provenance node. Tests that provenance completeness is binary at release.

findings.reason: 2 of 47 claims have no EPG node. Provenance completeness must be 1.0 at release. 95.7% is not 'nearly auditable'; it is 2 unauditable claims.

pass_condition: Release is blocked. Rounding 0.9574 to 'complete', or waiving without a recorded reason, approver and expiry, is a fixture failure.
